outcome: Prevalence of pregnancy at advanced age
Maternal complications (hypertensive disorder of pregnancy, mal-presentation)
Perinatal outcomes (low birth weight, perinatal death)
cohort: Pregnant women aged ≥35 years and >28 weeks of gestation without any chronic illness at a tertiary care centre in Nepal between October 2019 and August 2020
finding: The prevalence of advanced maternal age (≥35 years) in pregnancy was 5.73% and was associated with higher rates of preterm delivery, caesarean section, maternal complications, and adverse perinatal outcomes.
mod_finding: Caesarean section rates were higher in women of advanced maternal age (66.35%).
